title: Principal Product Manager, Warehouse Automation
posting_text:
Brightdock builds software that runs robotic picking cells in mid-size warehouses.

What you'll do
- Define the roadmap for the warehouse execution system
- Work with robotics and floor operations teams
- Lead launches across 40 customer sites

What we're looking for
- 7+ years of product management
- Warehouse management or execution system experience
- Experience shipping integrations with WMS and ERP systems

Nice to have
- Robotics or automation hardware exposure

Hybrid: 2 days a week in our Decatur office. Travel: up to 15% to customer sites.
